content: Every 'use server' action compiles to a public POST endpoint reachable by direct request — action IDs are encrypted and Origin/Host checked (CSRF) but that is NOT authorization. Each action must itself: 1) authenticate (re-read session inside action — proxy/layout checks do not extend to actions), 2) server-side zod validation at boundary (client zods are cosmetic), 3) authorization + ownership check (load row, compare ownerId to session user — stops IDOR). Page redirects/proxy checks only control UI rendering; a Server Action is a separate entry point and must re-verify. DAL pattern centralizes these checks so they don't drift across action files. Treat actions like public endpoints.
